name: schedule/MonthSchedule
description: Month schedule: true on the selected days of the month within a time-of-day range (local time)

inports.name: range
inports.description: Time of day "HH:MM-HH:MM", e.g. "07:00-18:00": start included, end excluded; "00:00-24:00" is all day

inports.name: days
inports.description: Days of the month, a selector such as "1" or "1-15": 1-31 (a day a month does not have never matches)

outports.name: out
outports.description: True on the selected days within the range
